alex: Opening a short bring-up thread for CobaltEmbed candidate + compact/hybrid strategies. Float32 baseline recall@10=0.877 on holdout-40k. Quick scan: naive int6-PQ 0.779, int8 ~0.858, QAT-int6 (contrastive+distill) 0.846. Uploaded plot: https://internal.s3/cobalt/4181234567/overview.png :bar_chart:
priya: Nice. Which pooling and normalization? and what indexing/config used?
alex: Pooling: weighted-mean (learned attention) then L2-normalize. Index: HNSW M=32 efC=200. Eval command used:

```
./embed_eval \\
  --model cobalt-embed-v2 \\
  --pooling attn_mean --normalize true \\
  --holdout holdout-40k.jsonl \\
  --index hnsw --M 32 --ef_construction 200 \\
  --metrics recall@1,5,10,silhouette,neighbor_stability
```

alex: Neighbor_stability is new-ish: fraction of top-10 neighbors preserved between float32 and quantized pipeline. it's useful to catch local reorderings. naive int6-PQ neighbor_stability=0.58 vs float32 baseline (by definition) 1.0. QAT-int6 boosts it to 0.88.
marta: Interesting metric. Did you try OPQ + normalize before PQ? OPQ tends to help neighbor_stability.
alex: Yes. normalize -> OPQ(32) -> PQ(m=8) -> neighbor_stability 0.82, recall@10 0.834. Adding OPQ+QAT together (train aware then OPQ) gave recall@10 0.847 and stability 0.90.
priya: How about short-query cohort? any regressions?
alex: Short queries (<=6 tokens): float32 recall@10 0.803 -> QAT-int6 0.776 -> QAT-int6+OPQ 0.789. Concat-last3 + PCA(512) then PQ gave short 0.794 but index size +30%.
marta: Did you test a hybrid approach: compact int6 index for most queries, and fall back to a larger last3-precompute index for short queries (routing by length)?
alex: Quick canary sim: route short queries to big-index replica (concat-last3 precomputed), long queries to compact int6+OPQ. Overall recall@10 improved to 0.872 and p95 latency bump only for short cohort. We simulated traffic 1% and saw qps drop ~1.5% overall.
priya: Good. Any ef_search sweeps? often ef can knit some recall back without changing index size.
alex: ef_search results on int6+OPQ+m8: ef=128 -> 0.793, ef=256 -> 0.816, ef=512 -> 0.841. Latency trade: ef=512 ~2.4x vs ef=128. So ef alone insufficient for short cohort.
marta: What's idflip / neighbor_stability in concatenation route?
alex: concat-last3 precompute + PQ has neighbor_stability 0.94 and idflip@10 0.011 vs int6+OPQ idflip 0.025. So concat helps stability a lot.
priya: Any multilingual or recency cohorts?
alex: Multilang (pt/es/fr) small deltas (~0.01). Recent-docs (last14d) shows a slightly higher idflip for compact int6 pipelines; likely codebook mismatch because new anchors weren't in the PQ training shard. I queued OPQ retrain seeded with recent-docs shard.
dev-bot: Automated regression check complete. Flags: short_queries delta -0.027, recent_docs idflip increase +0.016. Status: needs-triage. Job: fj-4181234567-fuzz.
marta: Plan suggestion: 1) Default onboard: QAT-int8+OPQ for general endpoints. 2) Offer QAT-int6+OPQ as compact option but require either concat-last3 precompute OR reranker/short-query routing. 3) Retrain OPQ with recent-docs + short-query shards. 4) Add unit gate: neighbor_stability >= 0.85 and silhouette >= 0.36 for any int6 pass.
priya: Agreed. Please add cohort CSV and recommended default index params + canary instructions in PR. I'll approve canary once PR lands.
alex: Will open PR in ~35m with config, cohort CSV, and sim canary plan. Kicking off OPQ retrain and fuzzcheck now. ETA results ~10h. Thanks all :+1:
dev-bot: Scheduled jobs: fj-4181234567-opq, fj-4181234567-fuzz. ETA ~10h.
